title: Pitch Display
description: Displays your pitch angle on the HUD. Customizable position, color, and keybinds.
body:
# Pitch Display

Shows your **pitch angle** on the HUD while playing Minecraft.

## Features
- Displays pitch angle (e.g. `40°`)
- Changes to `[ 40° ]` format near -70/-80 and 35/45 degrees
- **H key** → drag & drop HUD position
- **J key** → toggle HUD on/off
- Customizable color via ModMenu
- Position saved between sessions
- Snap to center
- Multi-language support

## Requirements
- Fabric API
- ModMenu (optional, for color settings)

## Supported Versions
- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Minecraft 1.21.11
